svg.text: Completion 17% (26 of 148 items implemented or verified) · Verified 0% (0) · Current milestone: M1 — Evidence
Generated from progress/progress.toml by tools/progress-gen. Completion = (implemented + verified) / total; floored.

rect.title: M0 — Foundation: Implemented — Stage A: workspace, hygiene, progress tooling, docs, Windows gate, CI and the source root all exist and work. RE applications are installed when first needed.

g.title: M1 — Evidence: Partial — Stage B: regulatory and official sources catalogued, official mobile software inventoried, formats identified.

M2 — Import: Partial — Stage C. Scanner, manifest, normalised layout and a repeatable first importer stage exist and are tested on synthetic files. No extraction from containers, and no real source material has been imported.
M3 — Headless game model: Partial — Stage D: state, spin, awards, feature state machine, deterministic traces. Runs on a synthetic fixture only; original mathematics unknown.

M4 — Golden Century Bevy slice: Partial — Stage E. A placeholder shell runs the synthetic fixture through the real simulation: window, reels, spin, Hold & Spin stepping. Nothing in it is Golden Century yet: no assets, no audio, no title data.

rect.title: M5 — Parity: Not started — Stage F: source-vs-rewrite traces, timing, screenshots, animation and audio events, discrepancies tracked.
M6 — Portability: Not started — Stage G: Windows verified, Linux and macOS build and test, Web/WASM builds and runs.
M8 — Game mathematics recovered and explained: Investigating — Parallel lane. Analysis tooling exists and is tested on the synthetic fixture; no original mathematics is held, and none is public.
M7 — Happy & Prosperous, Panda Magic, Autumn Moon: Not started — Generalise the systems proven on Golden Century to the other three titles.
Foundation / Repository bootstrap (workspace, licence, toolchain pin) — Implemented
Foundation / Legal and project policy — Implemented
Foundation / Evidence labels and provenance rules — Implemented
Foundation / Private source root outside Git — Implemented

g.title: Foundation / Windows development environment (reproducible) — Partial — Rust, MSVC, wasm32, Git, Python, Java, ffmpeg, and the Android emulator with platform tools are installed and recorded in docs/BUILDING.md. Decompiler applications are installed as the analysis needs them.

rect.title: Foundation / Windows pre-merge gate — Implemented — All nine steps active: fmt, clippy, test, hygiene, progress, app build, smoke launch, wasm32 build, release build.
Foundation / CI (Linux, Windows, macOS, wasm32 check) — Implemented
Foundation / Repository hygiene checker — Implemented
Foundation / Progress tracker and generator — Implemented
Foundation / Prior-art review (ASAMU-decomp, rea, universal-modder) — Implemented

g.title: Reverse engineering / Dragon Link cabinet and platform research — Partial — Three Australian generations and their platforms established from ACT instruments (docs/reverse-engineering/PLATFORMS.md); launch cabinet and what changed between generations unknown.

Reverse engineering / Regulatory source inventory — Partial — ACT and Victorian approvals catalogued with identifiers (docs/reverse-engineering/REGULATORY.md); no register found for NSW, Qld, SA, Tas, NT, WA; no RTP in any source.

Reverse engineering / Official mobile reference inventory — Partial — Mighty Fu Casino 5.6.0 obtained from the Play Store, hashed and inventoried, with the content it downloaded for Golden Century (docs/reverse-engineering/MOBILE_PACKAGE.md). The other three titles have not been opened, so their content is not held.

rect.title: Reverse engineering / Source provenance database (claims) — Implemented

g.title: Reverse engineering / Package and file-format identification — Partial — Tools exist and have been run on a real package: Unity IL2CPP identified; two unfamiliar formats measured, a MERC container and an .enc family consistent with a block cipher. Neither is understood yet.

rect.title: Reverse engineering / Executable analysis — Investigating — The app's native libraries and IL2CPP metadata are held; analysis has started. One 133 MB library is unexplained.

Reverse engineering / Asset-container identification — Investigating — Game content is in .mercury containers (signature MERC, not encrypted) and Unity asset bundles. The Mercury format is under analysis.
Reverse engineering / Texture and image extraction — Not started
Reverse engineering / Font identification — Not started
Reverse engineering / Audio extraction — Not started
Reverse engineering / Animation extraction — Not started

Reverse engineering / Configuration and data extraction — Investigating — The mobile build ships reel-strip, weighting and variation tables as .enc files on the device. Whether they can be read depends on that scheme, under analysis.

Reverse engineering / Mathematical-model investigation — Investigating — No cabinet mathematics is held and none is public. The mobile implementation's tables are on the device (rung 2 of the ladder, DECISIONS D-013) and under analysis; a public-sources pass is also running.
Mathematics and analysis / Per-constant provenance model — Implemented

Mathematics and analysis / Machine-readable game configuration — Implemented — Exercised only on the synthetic fixture. Cannot yet express free games, feature reels, weighted stops or progressive meters.
Mathematics and analysis / Exact base-game analysis (line and scatter return, composition) — Implemented

Mathematics and analysis / Exact Hold & Spin analysis (trigger, outcome distribution, value, jackpot frequency) — Implemented — For the generic one-chance-per-position feature model; the original feature mechanics are unknown.
Mathematics and analysis / Hit frequency and base-game variance by enumeration — Implemented
Mathematics and analysis / Seeded Monte Carlo with confidence intervals — Implemented
Mathematics and analysis / Progressive jackpot expected-value calculator — Implemented — Assumes probabilities independent of the meters. No meter model yet.
Mathematics and analysis / Configuration and version comparison — Implemented
Mathematics and analysis / Per-game technical report generator — Implemented
Mathematics and analysis / Whole-spin volatility — Implemented — Exact when the stop combinations can be enumerated; otherwise simulated with the run stated.
Mathematics and analysis / Free-games mathematics — Not started
Mathematics and analysis / Progressive meter model (contribution, increments, resets) — Not started
Mathematics and analysis / Virtual-reel and weighted-stop representation — Not started — Every stop is equally likely in the current model.

Mathematics and analysis / Reel-strip reconstruction from observed windows — Implemented — Window shares with intervals, a test of equal stop likelihood, an estimate of unseen windows, and exact strip assembly with the number of equivalent orders. Exercised on our own simulation only; no observed game yet. Feature probabilities are not reconstructed.
Mathematics and analysis / Automated spin collection from the official mobile app — Not started — Only needed if mobile outcomes are decided server-side. Needs the app installed (BLOCKERS B-003).
Mathematics and analysis / Statistical validation against captured gameplay — Not started

Mathematics and analysis / Recovered configuration: Golden Century — Investigating — No source held. An online evidence pass over litigation, regulatory, archival and research sources is under way (docs/BLOCKERS.md); it is not treated as blocked until those are exhausted.

Mathematics and analysis / Recovered configuration: Happy & Prosperous — Investigating — No source held. An online evidence pass over litigation, regulatory, archival and research sources is under way (docs/BLOCKERS.md); it is not treated as blocked until those are exhausted.

Mathematics and analysis / Recovered configuration: Panda Magic — Investigating — No source held. An online evidence pass over litigation, regulatory, archival and research sources is under way (docs/BLOCKERS.md); it is not treated as blocked until those are exhausted.

Mathematics and analysis / Recovered configuration: Autumn Moon — Investigating — No source held. An online evidence pass over litigation, regulatory, archival and research sources is under way (docs/BLOCKERS.md); it is not treated as blocked until those are exhausted.

Mathematics and analysis / Player-visible pay tables, lines and bet structures — Investigating — Not found in a first search. Footage of all four titles and pay-table screens in the litigation record exist; a frame-by-frame and full-filings pass is under way (docs/BLOCKERS.md).
Mathematics and analysis / Denomination and bet effects — Investigating — Lead: the complaint quotes different pay-table figures for two denominations. Nothing established for Australia.

Mathematics and analysis / Mathematical differences between program versions — Investigating — No source held. An online evidence pass over litigation, regulatory, archival and research sources is under way (docs/BLOCKERS.md); it is not treated as blocked until those are exhausted.

Mathematics and analysis / RNG architecture and call sites — Investigating — No source held. An online evidence pass over litigation, regulatory, archival and research sources is under way (docs/BLOCKERS.md); it is not treated as blocked until those are exhausted.

Mathematics and analysis / Outcome selection, reel-stop relationship and input timing — Investigating — No source held. An online evidence pass over litigation, regulatory, archival and research sources is under way (docs/BLOCKERS.md); it is not treated as blocked until those are exhausted.

Mathematics and analysis / State dependence and persistence between spins — Investigating — No source held. An online evidence pass over litigation, regulatory, archival and research sources is under way (docs/BLOCKERS.md); it is not treated as blocked until those are exhausted.
Mathematics and analysis / Mobile versus cabinet mathematics — Not started — Needs official mobile software (BLOCKERS B-003, in progress) and cabinet-side evidence.

Mathematics and analysis / Progressive break-even thresholds of the originals — Investigating — No source held. An online evidence pass over litigation, regulatory, archival and research sources is under way (docs/BLOCKERS.md); it is not treated as blocked until those are exhausted.

Mathematics and analysis / Classification of player beliefs against evidence — Not started — Classes defined in docs/reverse-engineering/math/QUESTIONS.md; none can be judged without a recovered configuration.
Shared game runtime / Outcome source abstraction (test, record, replay) — Implemented — Test instruments of ours. Models nothing about the original generator, which is unknown.

g.title: Shared game runtime / State machine — Partial — Idle and Hold & Spin phases with transactional commands; no free games, attract or idle states.
Shared game runtime / Credits / play-credit model — Partial — A play-credit meter with chained credit events; denominations and cash handling are not modelled.
Shared game runtime / Bet selection — Partial — Credits per line over all lines; the original's bet structure is unknown.
Shared game runtime / Spin lifecycle — Partial — Bet, reel stops, awards, feature entry, completion as events; ordering is ours, not evidenced.
Shared game runtime / Reel model — Partial — Strips with a wrapping window; how the original maps outcomes to stops is unknown.
Shared game runtime / Symbol model — Partial — Regular, wild, scatter and orb kinds; title symbol sets are unknown.
Shared game runtime / Pay evaluator — Partial — Generic left-to-right line rules and scatter pays, each stated in eval.rs; none checked against the original.
Shared game runtime / Win presentation — Partial — A status line per award and a meter that follows presented credit events. No count-up, no line highlighting, no animation.
Shared game runtime / Feature triggering — Partial — Hold & Spin by orb count only.
Shared game runtime / Hold & Spin framework — Partial — Parameterised respin loop with tests; trigger count, respins, chances and values are synthetic.
Shared game runtime / Jackpot model and presentation — Partial — Four named levels with fixed amounts; progressive meters and presentation are not started.

rect.title: Shared game runtime / Free-game framework — Not started
Shared game runtime / Audio — Not started
Shared game runtime / Animation — Not started
Shared game runtime / VFX — Not started

g.title: Shared game runtime / UI — Partial — Placeholder HUD: banner, credit meter, bet, status line, generated cells. Nothing reproduces the original UI.
Shared game runtime / Input — Partial — Keyboard only: spin and feature step, bet up and down, quit.
Shared game runtime / Save and settings handling — Partial — Game state serialises and resumes mid-feature; no settings, no persistence in an app.

Golden Century / Title identity, versions and regulatory identifiers — Partial — Four ACT specifications and two Victorian builds recorded (docs/reverse-engineering/GOLDEN_CENTURY.md); other jurisdictions and what changed between generations unknown.

rect.title: Golden Century / Reel layout and lines — Investigating — Five reels by three rows stated for the US family; lines and the Australian build unconfirmed.
Golden Century / Symbol set — Not started
Golden Century / Paytable — Not started
Golden Century / Denominations and bet options — Not started
Golden Century / Reel strips and weighting — Not started

Golden Century / Hold & Spin rules and presentation — Investigating — Trigger of six prize symbols confirmed in the mobile build's own strings and in the US complaint; not confirmed on an Australian build; presentation not started.
Golden Century / Jackpot levels and presentation — Not started

Golden Century / Free games feature — Investigating — Trigger of three scatters confirmed in the mobile build's own strings and in the US complaint; the mystery-symbol rule from official pages; count and retriggers unknown; not implemented.
Golden Century / Title artwork, UI layout and typography — Not started
Golden Century / Sound and music — Not started
Golden Century / Animation and sequence timing — Not started
Golden Century / Attract and idle presentation — Not started
Golden Century / Locally imported original assets — Investigating — The mobile build's Golden Century content is held (unencrypted containers). Nothing is extracted or imported yet.
Golden Century / Evidence-backed parity — Not started

Parity / Behavioural trace format — Implemented — One JSON Lines format for rewrite traces and transcribed observations; headers that would mislead are refused. No observation trace exists yet.
Parity / Source recordings of the original — Not started

Parity / Event comparison — Implemented — Event-by-event comparison that states what kind of comparison it is. Exercised on rewrite traces and on a rewrite relabelled as an observation; never on a real observation.

g.title: Parity / Timing comparison — Partial — Differences in event times are measured against a stated tolerance when both traces carry times. Headless rewrite traces carry none, and there is no recording to take times from.

rect.title: Parity / Visual comparison — Not started — The app can save a picture of its window from a reproducible unattended run (--smoke-frames with --screenshot); there is nothing to compare it with yet.
Parity / Audio comparison — Not started
Parity / Deterministic replay — Implemented — A recorded game of ours replays event for event from its draw log. This is determinism of our code, not parity.
Parity / Evidence-backed parity tests — Not started

g.title: Platforms / Windows — Partial — The app builds in debug and release and smoke-launches on the Windows host; the gate passes. Placeholder mode only.
Platforms / Linux — Partial — Headless crates and tools build and test in CI; no app yet.
Platforms / macOS — Partial — Headless crates and tools build and test in CI; no app yet.
Platforms / Web / WASM — Partial — The app compiles for wasm32-unknown-unknown in the gate and in CI. Not yet bundled or run in a browser.

Packaging / Source importer — Partial — Stage 1: loose files that already are standard media are copied into the asset set with their provenance and hashes. No container unpacking, no conversion, and no identification of what an asset is.

rect.title: Packaging / Asset manifest — Implemented — Logical id, source package and path, both hashes, media type, title, category, provenance class, confidence, method. Verified against files; exercised with synthetic files only.

g.title: Packaging / Local full-package workflow — Partial — dragonlink-pack verifies an asset set and assembles executable, assets and a do-not-distribute notice outside any Git tree. Exercised end to end with synthetic files; the application cannot display imported assets yet.
Packaging / Public asset-free build — Partial — The app runs with no assets in a clearly labelled placeholder mode. No packaged release yet.

rect.title: Packaging / Release process — Not started
